name: text_diff
description: Unified diff between two text blobs (AssemblyScript), the way `diff -u` shows one. WHEN TO USE: comparing two versions of text you already have in hand (two tool outputs, two file reads, a before/after) without writing either to disk first. Not for applying a patch — see patch_apply for that. Input: {"a": "...", "b": "...", "context": 3, "a_name": "a", "b_name": "b"}. Capped at 800 lines per side.

context.description: Lines of unchanged context per hunk. Defaults to 3.

a_name.description: Label for the --- header. Defaults to "a".

b_name.description: Label for the +++ header. Defaults to "b".
